# MonoTrue character metadata

The generated character role table selects codepoints and glyph names from
MonoTrue v0.2.0, commit
`1dfda76a564716e6148a342592b264a5b8b211e4`, Diagram Set 1.
MonoTrue derives from JuliaMono by cormullion. The upstream SIL Open Font License
1.1 notice is preserved in `LICENSE.txt`; JuliaMono is a Reserved Font Name.

Coral distributes the selected character metadata and its own renderer. It does
not distribute, modify or embed MonoTrue font binaries. Hosts supply the exact
validated font and retain its applicable notices. Controlled pictures use only
the adopted font identity and validated roles; copy/export remains ASCII.
